hypothesis: H5 repeated daily planning can incur unnecessary turnover; adding a strictly past out-of-sample mean-error ambiguity floor may reject uncalibrated active exposure. Separate cadence and uncertainty effects with matched controls.

calibration.cutoff: January 1 America/New_York of current model year
calibration.formula: e=realized_H5-prior_year_fit_OOF_prediction; b=mean(e); floor=b*b.T+HAC_Bartlett5_covariance_of_mean(e); new ambiguity=original training parameter Vmean(x)+floor
calibration.statistical_claim: Conservative ambiguity scale for average OOS bias; not predictive RMSE, not guaranteed conditional coverage; excludes future regime shifts and project search uncertainty.

execution: signal-date16:15ET decisions; next canonical open execution, daily next-open marking. No rebalance in four intermediate sessions; actual holdings drift and costs remain account-specific. Variance feasibility at rebalance only, not a pathwise realized guarantee. No terminal liquidation, cash zero yield, continuous shares.

gate_definition: Both cost scenarios: positive net log excess, >=6/7 positive complete signal years, median annual>0, removing any year leaves positive aggregate, MaxDD/CVaR5 no worse SOXX, rolling252 win rate>=60%, 20/60-block one-sided lower>0 (alpha=.05/2). Historical result cannot authorize production.
stopping: This registered batch has exactly three policy variants plus SOXX at two costs. Keep all failures, no result-dependent parameter edits or model selection. If it fails, diagnose before registering the next distinct mechanism; the overall user goal remains active.
